knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic content set
knowledge.detail: Eight fictional documents and ten tagged passages on two city capital projects.

knowledge.name: Briefing templates and routes
knowledge.detail: Five formats with audience, sections, reviewer, approver and working-day turnaround.

knowledge.name: Drafting rules and guardrails
knowledge.detail: Citation, conflicting-figure, gap and no-approval rules that bound every draft.

intelligence_processing.name: Template catalog
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists each format's audience and section structure from the template set.

intelligence_processing.name: Topic content scan
intelligence_processing.detail: Counts on-topic passages per document and reports measures with conflicting values.

intelligence_processing.name: Cross-document figure check
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares each measure across documents and lists every value with its sources.

intelligence_processing.name: Cited section drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Fills each template section from tagged passages with an inline document citation.

intelligence_processing.name: Gap detection
intelligence_processing.detail: Marks sections with no supporting passage and names who should supply the content.

intelligence_processing.name: Approval routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns the reviewer, approver and turnaround for the chosen format.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with six skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives briefing teams a drafting conversation once approved controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file BriefingPackBuilderAgent locally with deterministic operations.

management_reporting.name: Draft brief with sources
management_reporting.detail: Section-by-section draft with citations, a source list and a not-approved status.

management_reporting.name: Figure and gap registers
management_reporting.detail: Lists measures needing confirmation and sections needing input.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Six passing persona cases, package integrity and the unpublished Draft state.

tools.name: Portable BriefingPackBuilderAgent tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only briefing operations.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server that discovers the agent and exposes chat, health and tool routing.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; publishing requires explicit approval.

tools.name: SharePoint document library
tools.detail: Production seam for the governed source documents; not connected in the demonstration.

tools.name: Microsoft Word
tools.detail: Where officers finalize a draft; the agent itself writes no file in the demonstration.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: User surfaces for approved deployments; the package sends nothing.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only the bundled fictional content set and forbids browsing or outside facts.

supporting_features.name: Citation on every statement
supporting_features.detail: Each drafted section names the document it came from.

supporting_features.name: No silent figure choice
supporting_features.detail: Conflicting values are listed with their documents for a person to confirm.

supporting_features.name: Named gaps, never invented content
supporting_features.detail: Uncovered sections are marked for the owning department instead of written from general knowledge.

supporting_features.name: Human sign-off gate
supporting_features.detail: Review and approval follow the format's route; the agent never approves, files or sends.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona cases verify one operation each with exact evidence anchors.
